summary: Lunch break feature validated end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases pass covering GET /api/working-hours returning 'lunch' object, availability blocking 13:00/13:30 when enabled on multiple weekdays (Thu 2026-02-05 and Sat 2026-02-07), availability restoring those slots when disabled, PUT /api/lunch-break auth protection (403 without token), and correct interaction with schedule_override for 2026-03-12. Frontend: admin login OK, tab-schedule renders lunch-break-card with lunch-enabled toggle, lunch-start, lunch-end, lunch-save. Toggling lunch-enabled auto-saves (toast 'Descanso de almuerzo activado'/'desactivado'), inputs disabled when off, lunch-save works when on. Weekly sched-row-* still intact; Agenda/Servicios/Bloqueos/Clientes tabs open without errors. Final state: lunch ENABLED 13:00-14:00 as requested.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _compute_slots appends lunch as a single (start,end) tuple to busy — correct; overlap logic already handles containment. No regression on schedule_override path.
AdminDashboard SchedulePanel: lunch inputs are correctly disabled while enabled=false, preventing accidental edits. Good UX.
Consider migrating existing working_hours docs without 'lunch' field (already handled by on_start guard at server.py:1232) — OK.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral schedule_override for 2026-03-12 created and deleted within test; lunch left ENABLED (13:00-14:00) at teardown as required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature stable. Backend uses /api/auth/login (not /api/admin/login) for admin token. Booking page uses testids 'pick-service-<id>' rather than 'service-<id>'. Availability endpoint public.
